purpose: Pre-change friction and route inventory for Reform v2 Stage 4.
north_star: Routine LOW-risk work should look like route -> work -> verify -> done; internal checks, repair, receipts and fallback stay behind the owner surface.

measurement_scope.project_gate: scripts/vf_project_preflight.py auto-classification and current manifest resolution
measurement_scope.note: Authority/source/gate counts are static preflight burden. Runtime provider API-call counts are intentionally not guessed.

key_findings: The nine-source global baseline is paid by every sampled request before scope-specific work.
Eight of fourteen routine requests fall back to general_business, including Gmail, Drive, owner brief, Maya and internal status.
Instagram post/story/reel route to creative_publication, but Instagram carousel falls through to general_business and incorrectly receives a generic PASS rather than the creative evidence gate.
Creative preparation currently resolves 22 sources and 11 hard gates before production evidence can authorize work.
CAD read-only and CAD build receive the same six production gates, including printer/price/print-authority constraints that are irrelevant to a read-only inspection.
Project preflight PASS is path-resolution evidence only; Gmail, Drive, DCC and external effects still depend on separate downstream action gates.
Current Gmail transport is ready and current Maya route is READY_ACCEPTED_SURFACE, so routine friction should not be explained by unavailable tools.
